top_signals.title: India Saw 496 Million Escape Poverty Since 2011, World Bank Says
top_signals.summary: India saw about 496 million people lifted out of poverty between 2011 and 2023 in one of the world’s fastest declines in this metric, the World Bank said, although the gains remain uneven.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
